labor.name: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment

llcReport.title: File Periodic Report
llcReport.deadline: From 2 months before to 2 months after the periodic report month

corpReport.title: File Periodic Report
corpReport.deadline: From 2 months before to 2 months after the periodic report month

permitFee.note: $12 for a standard retail license issued July through December of even-numbered years and $16 for January through June, plus a $50 deposit for new retail accounts.

penalty.note: Greater of $15 or 10% of the unpaid tax plus 0.5% for each month it stays unpaid, up to 18%; the retailer's service fee is also lost.

unemployment.note: Employers owing delinquent premiums on June 30 pay the lesser of the past-due amount or 1% of taxable payroll, plus 1.5% monthly interest.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: An uninsured employer owes the uninsured employer fund 25% of the benefits due an injured employee (C.R.S. 8-43-408); the department also sets daily fines.

paidLeave.title: Colorado FAMLI premiums
paidLeave.description: Employers remit premiums quarterly via the FAMLI portal and may deduct up to half from employees.

local.title: Local sales tax licenses / business license
local.description: Home-rule cities (Denver, Aurora, Colorado Springs, etc.) self-collect sales tax and require their own licenses.

industry.health: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment

cannabis.regulator: Colorado Marijuana Enforcement Division (Department of Revenue)
